text: Here is the puzzle. Ether, ethoxyethane, has the formula C four H ten O. So does butan one ol. Same atoms, same mass. Yet the ether boils at thirty four point six degrees, it evaporates from your palm, while the alcohol boils at one hundred and seventeen. A gap of eighty three degrees.
